canonical_edition: F. Jacoby, Die Fragmente der griechischen Historiker 345 (part 3B, p. 208); the surviving attestation is Harpocration, Lexicon in decem oratores Atticos, s.v. κάθετος, in W. Dindorf (ed.), Oxford, 1853.
sources_tested: Canon 2250.001; exact local Perseus canonical Greek TEI `tlg1389.tlg001.perseus-grc2`, entry `k.kathetos`; its CTS metadata and repository CC BY-SA 4.0 licence; Harpokration On Line/Scaife passage check; FGrH 345 identity/concordance and targeted catalogue checks.
open_text_result: Exact surviving testimony available in licensed Greek TEI: Harpocration s.v. κάθετος states that Meliton discussed the kathetos in book 1 of On the clans at Athens. This is a citation/notice of the lost work, not a recovered continuous text of Meliton.
scan_result: No scan pursued: the exact ancient attestation is already available as a rights-cleared TEI text; no separate image acquisition is needed for this record.
next_action: Extract and retain the single Harpocration witness with full Perseus/Dindorf attribution and CC BY-SA 4.0 notice; label it explicitly as testimony to Meliton, not as a verbatim fragment of his lost book.
notes: Identity correction: this is Meliton of Athens (the historical writer, FGrH 345), not Melito of Sardis (TLG 1495). The open source’s Greek reads ‘διείλεκται περὶ τοῦ καθέτου Μελίτων ἐν α περὶ τῶν Ἀθήνησι γενῶν’; it preserves the work/title and subject, but no quoted wording from Meliton.
